key_insight: Hyperbolic IRL models rewards using hyperbolic distance, capturing non-separable feature interactions while improving prediction in low-data and dense environments.
engineering_relevance: Geometry-aware reward models offer a way to infer behavior from limited demonstrations while exposing interactions that linear reward models cannot represent.
method: Parameterize reward using hyperbolic distance between a feature vector and a learned parameter vector.
Evaluate a Euclidean-distance variant alongside linear and nonlinear IRL baselines.
Analyze human museum navigation to reveal joint effects of exhibit-distance features.
evidence_signal: Across established benchmarks with deterministic and stochastic policies, Hyperbolic IRL matched state-of-the-art performance overall and excelled with limited data and in dense environments.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify gains or computational costs, leaving practical trade-offs and generalization beyond the tested settings uncertain.
